question: With which of the following banks has the Government of India signed a $500 million project to build safe and green national highway corridors in Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian government and the **World Bank__** signed a $500 million agreement to create safe and environmentally friendly national highway corridors in Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The project will also help the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)** improve its ability to mainstream safety and green technologies.
 
• On behalf of the Indian government, Dr C S Mohapatra, Additional Secretary, Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, and Sumila Gulyani, Acting Country Director, India, signed the agreement.
 
• The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) loan, worth $500 million, has a maturity of** 18.5 years**, with a five-year grace period.
 
• The Green National Roadways Corridors Project will help MoRTH build 783 km of highways across a variety of geographies by incorporating safe and green technology designs including local and marginal materials, industrial byproducts, and other bioengineering solutions.
 
• The initiative will aid in the reduction of GHG(greenhouse gas ) emissions from highway building and maintenance.
 
• The chosen stretches in **Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh** would also assist in improving connectivity and promoting economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The **World Bank** is an international financial agency that helps low- and middle-income countries with loans and grants to fund capital projects.

 
 
• The headquarters of the World Bank is located in Washington, D.C., U.S.
 
• World Bank was formed in 1944.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** is an international financial institution.

 
 
• The headquarters of the IMF is located in Washington, D.C., U.S.
 
• IMF was formed on 27 December 1945.
 
 
 
• The **Asian Development Bank (ADB)** is a regional development bank established to promote social and economic development in Asia.
 
 
• The headquarters of the ADB is located in Manila, Philippines.
 
• ADB was formed on 19 December 1966.
 
 
 
• The **Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) **is an international development bank dedicated to improving Asia's economic and social conditions.
 
 
• The headquarters of the AIIB is located in Beijing, China.
 
• AIIB was formed on 16 January 2016.
